# The resting-state analysis is EXPLORATORY

## load packages and data

```{r message=F}
rm(list = ls())

library(psych) # v.2.4.6.26
library(here) # v.1.0.1
library(dplyr) # v.1.2.1
library(ggplot2) # v.4.0.2
library(ggpubr) # v.0.6.0
library(tidyr) # v.1.3.1
library(see) # v.0.12.0

df_commMeasures_raw <- 
  read.csv(here("Analysis_data", "coupling_comm_measures.csv"), sep=",")

df_commMeasures_frontoparietal_raw <- 
  read.csv(here("Analysis_data", "coupling_comm_measures_frontoparietal.csv"), sep=",")

df_commMeasures_rest_raw <- 
  read.csv(here("Analysis_data", "rest_coupling_comm_measures.csv"), sep=",")

df_commMeasures_frontoparietal_rest_raw <- 
  read.csv(here("Analysis_data", "rest_coupling_comm_measures_frontoparietal.csv"), sep=",")

df_BIS <- 
  read.csv(here("Data", "BIS_Complete_processed.csv"), sep = ";")

load(here("Data", "APM.RData"))

df_CD_raw <-
  read.csv(here("Analysis_data", "G04_CD_in_timewindows_4subs_removed.csv"), sep = ",")

```

## prepare dataset

```{r}
data_outlier <- dataACC
data_outlier$PropCorrOdd <- NA
data_outlier$PropCorrEven <- NA

data_outlier <- data_outlier %>% group_by(Subject) %>% 
  mutate(PropCorr = mean(Accuracy))
data_outlier <- data_outlier %>% group_by(Subject) %>% 
  mutate(PropCorrOdd = mean(Accuracy[Odd_Even == 1]))
data_outlier <- data_outlier %>% group_by(Subject) %>% 
  mutate(PropCorrEven = mean(Accuracy[Odd_Even == 2]))
data_outlier <- data_outlier%>% filter(RTms >= 150) 

dataACC <- data_outlier #dataACC = Spalte mit Prozentualer Richtigkeit und nur mit Trials, die RT über 150 ms haben

APM <- as.matrix(dataACC[,c("Subject", "PropCorrOdd", "PropCorrEven", "PropCorr")])
APM <- unique(APM)

df_intelligence <- merge(df_BIS, APM, by = "Subject", all = TRUE)
df_intelligence$numcorrect <- 36*df_intelligence$PropCorr

# remove invalid participants
df_intelligence <- df_intelligence[-c(216, 217, 218, 219, 220, 221, 222),]
df_intelligence <- df_intelligence[, c("Subject", "PC_Mean", "PS_Mean", "M_Mean", "C_Mean", "g_Mean", "PropCorrOdd", "PropCorrEven")]

df_intelligence$PC_Mean <- as.numeric(scale(df_intelligence$PC_Mean)) 
df_intelligence$PS_Mean <- as.numeric(scale(df_intelligence$PS_Mean))
df_intelligence$M_Mean <- as.numeric(scale(df_intelligence$M_Mean))
df_intelligence$C_Mean <- as.numeric(scale(df_intelligence$C_Mean))
df_intelligence$PropCorrOdd <- as.numeric(scale(df_intelligence$PropCorrOdd))
df_intelligence$PropCorrEven <- as.numeric(scale(df_intelligence$PropCorrEven))
```

## clean data
```{r}
# communication measures
df_commMeasures = df_commMeasures_raw
initial_NA_count <- sum(is.na(df_commMeasures))

for (x in 2:ncol(df_commMeasures)) {
  sample_mean = mean(df_commMeasures[,x], na.rm = TRUE)
  sample_SD = sd(df_commMeasures[,x], na.rm = TRUE)
  df_commMeasures[,x][df_commMeasures[,x] >
                        sample_mean+3*sample_SD] <- NA
  df_commMeasures[,x][df_commMeasures[,x] <
                        sample_mean-3*sample_SD] <- NA

}

final_NA_count <- sum(is.na(df_commMeasures))
num_NAs_generated_commMeasures <- final_NA_count - initial_NA_count
percentage_Exclusion_commMeasures <- num_NAs_generated_commMeasures/(nrow(df_commMeasures)*5)

# communication measures frontoparietal
df_commMeasures_frontoparietal = df_commMeasures_frontoparietal_raw
initial_NA_count <- sum(is.na(df_commMeasures_frontoparietal))

for (x in 2:ncol(df_commMeasures_frontoparietal)) {
  sample_mean = mean(df_commMeasures_frontoparietal[,x], na.rm = TRUE)
  sample_SD = sd(df_commMeasures_frontoparietal[,x], na.rm = TRUE)
  df_commMeasures_frontoparietal[,x][df_commMeasures_frontoparietal[,x] >
                        sample_mean+3*sample_SD] <- NA
  df_commMeasures_frontoparietal[,x][df_commMeasures_frontoparietal[,x] <
                        sample_mean-3*sample_SD] <- NA

}

final_NA_count <- sum(is.na(df_commMeasures_frontoparietal))
num_NAs_generated_commMeasure_fp <- final_NA_count - initial_NA_count
percentage_Exclusion_commMeasures_fp <- num_NAs_generated_commMeasure_fp/(nrow(df_commMeasures_frontoparietal)*5)


# communication measures rest
df_commMeasures_rest = df_commMeasures_rest_raw
initial_NA_count <- sum(is.na(df_commMeasures_rest))

for (x in 2:ncol(df_commMeasures_rest)) {
  sample_mean = mean(df_commMeasures_rest[,x], na.rm = TRUE)
  sample_SD = sd(df_commMeasures_rest[,x], na.rm = TRUE)
  df_commMeasures_rest[,x][df_commMeasures_rest[,x] >
                        sample_mean+3*sample_SD] <- NA
  df_commMeasures_rest[,x][df_commMeasures_rest[,x] <
                        sample_mean-3*sample_SD] <- NA

}

final_NA_count <- sum(is.na(df_commMeasures_rest))
num_NAs_generated_commMeasures_rest <- final_NA_count - initial_NA_count
percentage_Exclusion_commMeasures_rest <- num_NAs_generated_commMeasures_rest/(nrow(df_commMeasures_rest)*5)

# communication measures frontoparietal
df_commMeasures_frontoparietal_rest = df_commMeasures_frontoparietal_rest_raw
initial_NA_count <- sum(is.na(df_commMeasures_frontoparietal_rest))

for (x in 2:ncol(df_commMeasures_frontoparietal_rest)) {
  sample_mean = mean(df_commMeasures_frontoparietal_rest[,x], na.rm = TRUE)
  sample_SD = sd(df_commMeasures_frontoparietal_rest[,x], na.rm = TRUE)
  df_commMeasures_frontoparietal_rest[,x][df_commMeasures_frontoparietal_rest[,x] >
                        sample_mean+3*sample_SD] <- NA
  df_commMeasures_frontoparietal_rest[,x][df_commMeasures_frontoparietal_rest[,x] <
                        sample_mean-3*sample_SD] <- NA

}

final_NA_count <- sum(is.na(df_commMeasures_frontoparietal_rest))
num_NAs_generated_commMeasure_fp_rest <- final_NA_count - initial_NA_count
percentage_Exclusion_commMeasures_fp_rest <- num_NAs_generated_commMeasure_fp_rest/(nrow(df_commMeasures_frontoparietal_rest)*5)

# CD values
df_CD = df_CD_raw[,c(1,6:13)]

# remove subjects that score at or below chance level in switching task 
# this was already done before average CD values were computed in the time windows
# df_CD <- df_CD[-c(41, 162, 186, 187),]

initial_NA_count <- sum(is.na(df_CD))

for (x in 2:ncol(df_CD)) {
  sample_mean = mean(df_CD[,x], na.rm = TRUE)
  sample_SD = sd(df_CD[,x], na.rm = TRUE)
  df_CD[,x][df_CD[,x] >
                        sample_mean+3*sample_SD] <- NA
  df_CD[,x][df_CD[,x] <
                        sample_mean-3*sample_SD] <- NA

}

final_NA_count <- sum(is.na(df_CD))
num_NAs_generated_CD <- final_NA_count - initial_NA_count
percentage_Exclusion_CD <- num_NAs_generated_CD/(nrow(df_CD)*8)


```


## plot communication measures and get means and SDs

```{r}
## residualized timeseries
colnames(df_commMeasures) <- c("Subject", "DE", "–SI", 
                               "PT", "RE", "C")
df_commMeasures_long <- pivot_longer(df_commMeasures, cols = c(2:6))
colnames(df_commMeasures_long) <- c("Subject", "Measure", "Value")

summary_df <- df_commMeasures_long %>%
  group_by(Measure) %>%
  summarise(mean_val = mean(Value, na.rm = T),
            sd_val = sd(Value, na.rm = T))

df_commMeasures_long$Measure <- factor(
  df_commMeasures_long$Measure,
  levels = c("DE", "–SI", "PT", "RE", "C")
)

my_colors <- c(
  "DE" = "#a1dab4",
  "–SI" = "#253494",
  "PT" = "#41b6c4",
  "RE" = "#2c7fb8",
  "C"  = "#ffffcc")

my_colors1 <- c(
  "DE" = "#67001f",
  "–SI" = "#b2182b",
  "PT" = "#d6604d",
  "RE" = "#f4a582",
  "C"  = "#fddbc7")

my_colors2 <- c(
  "DE" = "#053061",
  "–SI" = "#2166ac",
  "PT" = "#4393c3",
  "RE" = "#92c5de",
  "C"  = "#d1e5f0")

my_colors3 <- c(
  "DE" = "#543005",
  "–SI" = "#8c510a",
  "PT" = "#bf812d",
  "RE" = "#dfc27d",
  "C"  = "#f6e8c3")

my_colors4 <- c(
  "DE" = "#003c30",
  "–SI" = "#01665e",
  "PT" = "#35978f",
  "RE" = "#80cdc1",
  "C"  = "#c7eae5")

violin_plot <- ggplot(df_commMeasures_long, aes(x = Measure, y = Value, fill= Measure)) +
  geom_violinhalf(position = position_nudge(x = .2, y = 0)) +
  geom_jitter(shape=16, position=position_jitter(0.15), size = 0.8) +
```

## combine data

```{r}
df_commMeasures[, 2:6] <- scale(df_commMeasures[, 2:6])
df_commMeasures_rest[, 2:6] <- scale(df_commMeasures_rest[, 2:6])
df_commMeasures_frontoparietal[, 2:6] <- scale(df_commMeasures_frontoparietal[, 2:6])
df_commMeasures_frontoparietal_rest[, 2:6] <- scale(df_commMeasures_frontoparietal_rest[, 2:6])
df_CD[, 2:9] <- scale(df_CD[, 2:9])

df_commMeasures$Subject <- as.numeric(sub("sub-", "", df_commMeasures$Subject))
df_commMeasures_rest$Subject <- as.numeric(sub("sub-", "", df_commMeasures_rest$Subject))
df_commMeasures_frontoparietal$Subject <- as.numeric(sub("sub-", "", df_commMeasures_frontoparietal$Subject))
df_commMeasures_frontoparietal_rest$Subject <- as.numeric(sub("sub-", "", df_commMeasures_frontoparietal_rest$Subject))

df <- df_commMeasures %>%
  select(Subject, DE, "–SI", PT, RE, C) %>%
  full_join(
    df_intelligence %>% 
      select(Subject, PC_Mean, PS_Mean, C_Mean, M_Mean, g_Mean, PropCorrOdd, PropCorrEven),
    by = "Subject"
  )

df_rest <- df_commMeasures_rest %>%
  select(Subject, DE, "–SI", PT, RE, C) %>%
  full_join(
    df_intelligence %>% 
      select(Subject, PC_Mean, PS_Mean, C_Mean, M_Mean, g_Mean, PropCorrOdd, PropCorrEven),
    by = "Subject"
  )

df_frontoparietal <- df_commMeasures_frontoparietal %>%
  select(Subject, DE, "–SI", PT, RE, C) %>%
  full_join(
    df_intelligence %>% 
      select(Subject, PC_Mean, PS_Mean, C_Mean, M_Mean, g_Mean, PropCorrOdd, PropCorrEven),
    by = "Subject"
  )

df_frontoparietal_rest <- df_commMeasures_frontoparietal_rest %>%
  select(Subject, DE, "–SI", PT, RE, C) %>%
  full_join(
    df_intelligence %>% 
      select(Subject, PC_Mean, PS_Mean, C_Mean, M_Mean, g_Mean, PropCorrOdd, PropCorrEven),
    by = "Subject"
  )

df_CD$ERPset_new <- sub("switching_sub-", "", df_CD$ERPset)
df_CD$Subject <- as.numeric(sub("_bin_average", "", df_CD$ERPset_new))

df <- df_CD %>%
  select(Subject, E_CD_OE_R, E_CD_OE_S, E_CD_LM_R, E_CD_LM_S, 
         L_CD_OE_R, L_CD_OE_S, L_CD_LM_R, L_CD_LM_S) %>%
  full_join(df, by = "Subject"
  )

df_rest <- df_CD %>%
  select(Subject, E_CD_OE_R, E_CD_OE_S, E_CD_LM_R, E_CD_LM_S, 
         L_CD_OE_R, L_CD_OE_S, L_CD_LM_R, L_CD_LM_S) %>%
  full_join(df_rest, by = "Subject"
  )

df_frontoparietal <- df_CD %>%
  select(Subject, E_CD_OE_R, E_CD_OE_S, E_CD_LM_R, E_CD_LM_S, 
         L_CD_OE_R, L_CD_OE_S, L_CD_LM_R, L_CD_LM_S) %>%
  full_join(df_frontoparietal, by = "Subject"
  )

df_frontoparietal_rest <- df_CD %>%
  select(Subject, E_CD_OE_R, E_CD_OE_S, E_CD_LM_R, E_CD_LM_S, 
         L_CD_OE_R, L_CD_OE_S, L_CD_LM_R, L_CD_LM_S) %>%
  full_join(df_frontoparietal_rest, by = "Subject"
  )

```

## compute skewness and kurtosis
```{r}
## check for univariate normality
which_df <- df # chose df, df_rest, df_frontoparietal, df_frontoparietal_rest
summary_stats <- describe(which_df[,2:21])
range(summary_stats$skew)
range(summary_stats$kurtosis)

```

```{r}
save(df_rest, file=here("Analysis_data", "df_rest.Rda"))
save(df_frontoparietal_rest, file=here("Analysis_data", "df_frontoparietal_rest.Rda"))
```
